name: interlayered contact and separation

definition_zh: 相邻轨道结构层之间接触状态保持或中断的过程。

complete_examples.text: However, the interlayered contact and separation are nonlinear processes in the numerical domain.
In this work, the nonlinear process is the interlayered contact and separation between the base plate and soil surface.
